rank_definition: 1 is least risky and N is most risky.

portfolios.rationale: This baseline portfolio contains the two extracted services and represents the lowest combined exposure in the comparison set.
The additional Spotify service instance adds another streaming profile with location and network-address collection.
Two search-service instances increase the contribution from location tracking and email-sharing clauses.
The portfolio is dominated by repeated streaming-service exposure, including location sharing and IP logging.
Repeated instances of both services combine tracking, location, network-address, and email-sharing risks.
This portfolio has the greatest repeated exposure to the extracted Spotify clauses, so it is assigned the highest risk.
